title: pmkit config
description: The pmkit config of a repository, in .pmkit/config.yaml. It names the tracker, the git host and the write policy. Keys pmkit does not know are allowed.

version.title: Config version
version.description: The version of this file's format. Always 1.

system.title: Tracker system
system.description: The tracker pmkit reads and writes. local works today. A hosted system works once pmkit has its adapter.

path.title: Tracker path
path.description: Local only. The folder of the local tracker, relative to the repository root. When it is missing or empty (null), pmkit uses .issues.

scope.title: Tracker scope
scope.description: Hosted trackers only: the names that pick the team, project or space, such as team: ENG. GitHub Issues uses host (such as github.com), repo (owner/name) and project (the Project's owner/number, or none). Jira uses site (the site's host, such as acme.atlassian.net) and space (the space key, such as ENG). Ignored by the local tracker.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace of a hosted tracker, as the URL key in its web address, such as acme.

additionalProperties.title: Scope name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the team, project or space this key picks, such as ENG.

system.title: Git host system
system.description: github opens pull requests with the gh CLI; bitbucket opens pull requests through the Bitbucket Cloud REST API with BITBUCKET_TOKEN; none turns pull requests off.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The repository on the git host, as owner/repo.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch pull requests target, such as main.

write_policy.title: Write policy
write_policy.description: When pmkit asks before it writes to the tracker.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: When a command asks before a write: all_writes, single_writes or none. none never skips a preview.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The changes that always show a full preview first.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: Hosted trackers only: how pmkit's statuses and field roles map to the tracker's own names.

status.title: Status mappings
status.description: A category, or blocked, to the tracker's status name, such as in_review: In Review. On GitHub Issues it is an option of the Project's Status field, or label:<name> for a repository label when tracker.scope.project is none. none means this team has no such status.

additionalProperties.title: Status name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the tracker's status for this category, or none when the team has no such status.

fields.title: Field mappings
fields.description: A field role to the tracker's field name, native for the tracker's own field, or none for no field. GitHub Issues names the source: issue:<name> for an issue field, project:<name> for a field of the Project.

additionalProperties.title: Field name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the tracker's field for this role, native for the tracker's own field, or none for no field.

priority.title: Priority labels
priority.description: GitHub Issues without a Project only (tracker.scope.project: none, mappings.fields.priority: none): a pmkit priority level to label:<name>, the repository label that stands for it, such as high: label:P1, or none. See ADR 0012.

additionalProperties.title: Label
additionalProperties.description: label:<name> of a repository label, or none.

estimate.title: Estimate labels
estimate.description: GitHub Issues without a Project only (tracker.scope.project: none, mappings.fields.estimate: none): an estimate value to label:<name>, the repository label that stands for it, such as 3: label:size: 3. The keys, in order, are the estimate scale: points when every key is a number, sizes otherwise. See ADR 0012.

additionalProperties.title: Label
additionalProperties.description: label:<name> of a repository label, or none.

types.title: Type mappings
types.description: A pmkit issue type to the name of one label of the tracker, or of one issue type on GitHub Issues, such as bug: Bug. On GitHub Issues with no enabled issue type, label:<name> names a repository label. A type without one is left out.

additionalProperties.title: Label name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the tracker's label for this issue type.
